notes: All pending records were excluded from training and used only for inference.
The saved v5 label is compared with v6 primary-classifier inference on the archived event clip.
Because all 894 original RTSP source paths are unavailable and review clips are MP4V-encoded crops, the stored-label-to-v6 changes are estimates, not exact full-resolution replays.
The same-clip v5-to-v6 comparison re-runs both primary classifiers on identical archived clips; it is the fairer comparison available from retained data.

replay_comparison_limitations.interpretation: The pending clips are MP4V-encoded crops, while the stored v5 scores came from live frames. Original source chunks are unavailable. The stored-label-to-v6 count is an estimate from archived clips; the same-clip v5/v6 comparison is the fairer replay comparison, and neither is an exact full-resolution live re-run.
replay_comparison_limitations.gate_replay_excluded: Foreground-gate scores on archived clips did not reproduce the queue's original accepted-event state; do not interpret them as exact v5-to-v6 cascade transitions.
